Whereas the Americans of Disabilities Act, ADA, signed into law on July 26, 1990, is landmark civil rights legislation that protects the rights of individuals with disabilities and promotes equal access and opportunity in all areas of public life.

And whereas the ADA has enhanced access and opportunities for people with disabilities by reducing barriers and promoting inclusion, however, continued efforts are needed to address ongoing accessibility challenges and to advance equal access for all members of the community.

And whereas according to the 2024 American Community Survey, approximately 31,924 Loudoun County residents, or 7.2% of the population, identifies having a disability highlighting the importance of accessible programs, services, facilities, communication and community engagement and whereas July 26, 2026 marks the 36th anniversary of the ADA and provides an opportunity to recognize the progress achieved while reaffirming the ongoing responsibility to advance accessibility, inclusion and equal opportunity for people

with disabilities, and whereas Loudoun County is committed to ADA compliance and to ensuing equitable access to programs, services, and information for individuals with disabilities, and is conducting an ADA self-evaluation and transition plan project to identify and address accessibility barriers through a coordinated and data-informed approach.

The transition plan will establish a phased framework to prioritize and address barriers based on impact, feasibility, and regulatory requirements, and whereas Loudoun County encourages residents, businesses, organizations, and community partners to reaffirm the principles of accessibility, inclusion, and equal opportunity embodied in the ADA and to continue working toward a more accessible and inclusive community for all.

Now, therefore, be it resolved that the Loudoun County Board of Supervisors does hereby proclaim July 2026, July 26, 2026, as Americans with Disabilities Act Awareness Day in Loudoun County and urges all residents to celebrate the many and varied contributions of people with disabilities and support the value and talent that people with disabilities add to our community.
